_Hey everyone, here is a Homebrew custom script based on characters in the harry Potter universe, and is currently undergoing Playtesting both online and IRL. The script is inspired by previous Harry Potter themed scripts on the Reddit, and has also had some help from BOTC user Lumious. Currently only posting the character sheet, and (incorrect) night order sheet. Will follow up with the Json file soon._

_The Dark Lord and his Deatheaters have infiltrated Hogwarts, Will the brave wizards and witches uncover his plot? Or will Night fall upon the Wizarding World once more?_

大家好，這裡有一個基於哈利·波特宇宙角色的自制劇本，目前線上上和線下進行過測試(原文來自1年前)。該劇本靈感源自Reddit上之前的哈利·波特主題劇本，同時也得到了BOTC使用者Lumious的協助，並由Max進行了重製改編。

黑魔王與食死徒已潛入霍格沃茨，勇敢的巫師們能否揭穿他的陰謀？還是魔法世界將再度陷入黑暗？
